name: Gamen kara Detekita Oshi Vtuber to H na Dousei Seikatsu ~Muma Kawa ASMR Haishinsha wa Jirai-kei ?~
original_name: 画面から出てきた推しVtuberとHな同棲生活 ～夢魔かわASMR配信者は地雷系？～
source:
Masato Kasakabe has a miserable job that's constantly overworking him.
His sole pleasure is supporting his favorite vtubers.

"Ahh, if only my oshi jumped through the screen right now..."

Masato starts fantasizing about living with his oshi.
But that could never happen for real...

Until suddenly, he ends up with three of his favorites as his roommates.
With vtubers now existing in the flesh, a dimension-spanning love story begins now...


[b]Slightly psycho succubus ASMR streamer?[/b]

After Masato loses his job, and with it, all motivation, Amu suggests that he become her slave.

Masato gradually starts to regain energy for life as he serves Amu as her slave.

Amu keeps acting suggestive.
"She must be into me"... Having convinced himself of that, Masato summons up the courage to ask her out, but...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2699620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
春日部正人的工作苦不堪言，总是被迫加班。
他唯一的乐趣，就是支持自己喜欢的虚拟主播。

“唉，要是我推现在就能从屏幕里跳出来就好了……”

正人沉浸在与心仪主播同居的幻想中。
可这种事，怎么可能真的发生……

谁知突然之间，他最喜欢的三位主播竟然都成了室友。
与化为真实存在的虚拟主播们，一段跨越次元的恋爱故事就此展开……

[b]有点病娇的魅魔ASMR主播？[/b]

正人失业后，连生活的动力也一起丢失了。这时，阿姆提议让他成为自己的奴隶。

在作为奴隶照料阿姆日常起居的过程中，正人渐渐找回了生活的活力。

阿姆不断作出引人遐想的举动。
“她肯定对我有意思”……正人这样说服自己，鼓起勇气向她告白，然而……

（摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2699620/]Steam[/url]）
